snippet.title: Croissant - Release Trailer
snippet.description:
🎮Play Croissant (Steam, Itch): https://limsodgames.com/croissant

Croissant is a clicker game, click the Croissant to gain even more Croissant and become the best in the leaderboard! By spending time on the game, or by clicking on the Croissant, you can obtain skins. Collect them or trade them to expand your collection.
